name: echo chat ping
description: Proposal, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x), a generic cream chat bubble in the top right corner with dark dots, no app mark and no words: the creature rests and blinks, the bubble pops in with one dot and four flashing ping ticks and the creature perks up two rows taller with its antenna pinging and its eyes looking up at it, a second dot arrives and it bounces, still keen, then a third arrives and it sags two rows, the antenna flops over, the lids half drop, the eyes look down and a grey sigh puff drifts off its side, then the bubble shrinks away and it comes back up to rest; judge whether the perk and the slump read at a glance, whether the flopped antenna reads as a droop rather than a broken part, and whether it is still this creature.
